title: Day 24/28 - How To Import Existing Terraform Resources Azure (simply explained)
description:
🔍 Learn how to import existing Azure resources into Terraform | Complete Step-by-Step Tutorial
In this comprehensive guide for DevOps engineers and cloud professionals, we'll explore multiple approaches to importing your existing Azure infrastructure into Terraform code. Whether you're migrating legacy infrastructure or adopting Infrastructure as Code (IaC) practices, this tutorial covers everything you need to know about Terraform import workflows.

📚 What you'll learn:
Master the official Terraform import command for bringing existing resources under Terraform management
Watch a live demonstration of importing a production website into Terraform code
Discover how to use AZExport for bulk resource importing
Learn advanced importing techniques with Terraformer
Understand best practices and common pitfalls when importing Azure resources

💡 Practical demonstration:
Follow along as we import a live Azure website into Terraform, demonstrating real-world scenarios and troubleshooting tips. Perfect for DevOps engineers looking to implement Infrastructure as Code in their existing Azure environments.

🎓 Part of our complete "28 Days of Azure Terraform" course, helping you master Infrastructure as Code on Azure.
